parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides one grip for the user to hold and apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw to open and close against the other blade handle set, enabling cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is the second blade and handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting pair, providing the opposing edge and handle for the user’s other fingers.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw in coordination with the first blade handle set to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw located at the pivot point of the scissors.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the two blade handle sets and allows them to rotate smoothly relative to each other.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around its axis.
